dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Ways to Make a Fortune...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Guess what? Paimon just thought of the best Mora-making idea ever!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Just look how many people pass by this place every day. If we opened a business here, right outside the Stadium, we'd make a fortune without even trying!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uhhh... maybe... alchemical potions from Mondstadt?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I think there's already people selling similar stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: In that case, ummm... Ooh! Ores from Liyue! Yeah, we could make a killing off of those!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Pretty sure the Children of Echoes are already in that business, too...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, yeah... Wait, Paimon's got it — rugs from Sumeru! Those'll definitely be a hit!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, that's the specialty of the Masters of the Night-Wind.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well then... Then we'll fence the whole Stadium up! And charge an admission fee to everyone who tries to get inside, whether they're a contestant or a spectator!

choices.text: Pretty sure someone will take you into custody...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grrrrrrrr! Why does getting rich have to be so hard?
